retarget.scope: Pelvis and torso orientation, morphology-scaled ankle paths, source-derived contact timing and heading. Arms remain nominal; not a full-body or known-good G1 reference.
retarget.stance_policy: Lock each inferred stance to median horizontal ankle position and a flat G1 foot at z=0.035 m. Quintic correction blending during intervening swings.
retarget.foot_orientation: Source-derived horizontal foot yaw, held per stance and blended during swing; flatten pitch/roll for G1.
retarget.root_policy: Uniform leg-length morphology scale, source root displacement and full orientation, one constant ground-height offset. Deterministically lower pelvis only where needed to keep hip-to-ankle reach within 98% of G1 leg length, by at most 0.06 m. Align net source travel to +X; preserve timing.
retarget.lookahead_policy: Hold the last resampled pose beyond source duration; recompute finite-difference velocities consistently through the hold.

interpretation: One 3.72-second source segment, no time warping, speed sweep or repeated physical tuning. One verified step per foot adapts the former two-per-foot eight-second gate to this shorter clip and excludes initial airborne landing. Progress must be 70-130% of retargeted reference; other physical limits unchanged. A reference validation failure prevents policy execution and is persisted rather than relaxed.
